notes.title: August update
notes.content: [p]Hi everybody! In the past weeks we've mostly been working on redesigning existing 3D objects and adding new ones to make the game more appealing. Throughout the past year we have gotten better at 3D modelling and while one must just say 'this is good enough' at some point, we decided we were not there yet.[/p][p][/p][h3]Main character redesign[/h3][p]The original Chirpy was probably the first object that we created in Blender (can you tell?). As it is the main character of our game it definitely needed a facelift. We are quite close to the finish line regarding the mesh and will start to work on the animations and coloring in the next weeks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/7a3049ac8362f37bf5e7e03ec40143cce34b1558.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/543a30862f9387844f734a6b4d043a7c54e2277c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Trees redesign[/h3][p]Trees are quite important in our game - it's called 'Isle of trees' for a reason. That is why we decided to make them from scratch as well. Currently they just seem too flat and we were way to careful regarding the polycount. Premature optimization is the root of all evil.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/d44bda3ae9c9d50913933248843f2528e6de64fa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]New foliage[/h3][p]Mostly forest areas are lacking some details and feel a bit empty. That is why we are working on new foliage to make the world lusher. We've also decided to add some grass, but just as a detail around other objects - having huge fields of swaying grass did not seem to fit our art stile and would have an impact on performance as well.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/54432eb2a0fcb307faab308c5fbfb5574835cba2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/8bb7d518935eb54ccffee8bf4f71f7b4b3124652.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Can't wait for the September update, ha?[/p][p][/p][p]M&V[/p]

notes.title: July update
notes.content:
[p]Hi everybody! Here are the major updates from the past few weeks. It's been a busy time.[/p][p][/p][h3]New collectibles - berries![/h3][p]We added new collectibles to the game! Alongside seeds that are required to replant the trees and worms that are required for Grandma's famous worm pie, you can now collect berries as well! They are the island's [b]currency,[/b] so make sure to gather them! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/5177f254a8c15ede5815f9474b8b840618b27560.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Shop[/h3][p]Shoooopiiing! Berries are the island's currency, so what good are they to you if you can't spend them? We added a [b]shop[/b] where you will be able to buy equipment (either required to complete quests or just to show off). The shop is run by an albatross (often confused for a goose) named Bob. Bob is a businessman.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/a2472fa66025f751cedfe091ce05d2507e876168.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The shop is already fully functional, but has (like everything else) a super ugly UI. This is just a placeholder, and we plan to tackle the UI appearance as a whole at some point.
What should you be able to buy in a shop like this?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/fcd48a174ca15eab3f0289b9bed8642b45bdae72.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy August![/p][p][/p][p]M&V[/p]

notes.title: June update
notes.content:
[p]Hi everybody! Here are the major updates from the past few weeks.[/p][p][/p][h3]New part of the map (remains to be named)[/h3][p]We've added a new island to the map. It should have a name but it doesn't have one yet (any suggestions?). It's a rainy remote place that has a different more gloomy vibe than the rest of the map. The constant rain, the abandoned graveyard and the ruins help with this. It is worth exploring though! Something important is hidden in that area![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/4d9ea93895b59a75c12a2f5d723c6f553120f142.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]New part of the map - Great divide[/h3][p]We've added another part of the map. Again it's an island. It will also play an important part in the game's progress. This area is known for it's strong winds, currents and steep walls that make it impossible to pass. The only way to get to the other side is to go through a narrow pass in the middle. What's on the other side? Can't tell yet but it's both fun and important.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/a986963bc7583ec072a48d3417c99fab960ac565.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Isle of trees is on Youtube![/h3][p]We've launched the Youtube [url="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnZ-d05WV8vh8oJlbLaKOBQ"]channel[/url] and started posting shorts covering different topics. Make sure to subscribe to stay up to date with our progress.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/b033a182bb83d030e3aab7c6fe5ffb29c9fdb115.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Enjoy July!

M&V[/p]

notes.title: May update
notes.content:
To be honest, in the past few weeks our focus was mainly on marketing. It requires much more work than we initially thought it would. We were preparing content for social media and discussing different approaches on how to promote our game. We've started posting on Bluesky and plan to expand to Youtube in the next weeks as well.

Regarding the development we were mostly dealing with weather - adding different weather conditions and optimizing the existing ones to make the world more versatile.

We've had clouds before but they are now fine tuned and optimized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/25c1b5e54027dcc484e602ffccdad6727584025b.jpg[/img]
 
We've also added rain to some mysterious areas that simply require that kind of weather for the proper vibe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/59547dbaf468e1db2230569deaea116ff6bc2829.jpg[/img]

Enjoy the month of June!

M&V

notes.title: April update
notes.content:
Hi all!

In beginning of April we've set up the Steam page so in the past month quite some time was dedicated 
to fine tuning the content and letting people on social media know we exist (screaming into the void much? :D).
Regarding the development there are two things we would like to share with you.

[h2]UI functionality[/h2]
UI is a big area that we have not worked on at all until just a few weeks ago. At this point we have a very [b]ugly but almost fully functional[/b] UI consisting of the menu, main menu and the inventory. As we have no previous experience with it the first milestone was to define the required components and get them to function the way they are supposed to. At least to some extent. The next step is to design the user interface and fine tune the user experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/4fe3cd9407267252726804b4ebc391c859147cd6.png[/img]

[h2]Visual appearance of the game[/h2]
For this one we are [b]really happy[/b] ːsteamhappyː. We knew it had to be done for a while but only got around to doing it in the past few weeks.
The game felt a bit cold, empty and flat. The biggest step was to add variety to the terrain textures. All grass surfaces are now covered with 3 different textures that are applied according to a noise texture. Additionally we've modeled some extra versions of bushes and other plants and added some vegetation and life to the map in general. Some extra geography also helped make the environment feel more diverse.

[b]Before:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/d5e4149e1125005560ae4bc3be5aeddcded631d3.jpg[/img]

[b]After:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/d427bf8c98cd32578e42664f1f99c8147bd19a4d.jpg[/img]

[b]Before:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/5ca6d32e575a22e0f75d701a2f8dd05522c590fb.jpg[/img]

[b]After[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571953/310dd1337dcb94aef8873b07cb4f7cf970179bb7.jpg[/img]

We think it looks way better now and are happy with the progress. We'll continue with the fine tuning of the visual appearance of the game in the next months.

Enjoy the month of May!

M&V
